verdict.rationale: Flagright ships automations (Rule Engine, Workflow Builder, rule instances updated via the Management API), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents version history, review or approval of changes, or rolling back to a prior rule or workflow version. Idempotent updates and rule simulation are adjacent features: simulation is pre-deployment testing, not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
